title: LIN-4377 Part B2: simple-dispatcher re-copies the contract, shares one DONE: rule and one tool join, README points to Harbour
description:
## As asked

Repository: JKershaw/simple-dispatcher. This is the **second half of the plan's Part B**: one SD PR. It is **blocked by** the LinearViewer contract subtask, because it copies that piece's **merged** `contract.json` bytes.

**Change from the plan, with the reason:** the plan has SD copy from the LV PR head, say "merge after LinearViewer #N", and re-pin `LV_COMMIT` after the squash. Breakdown made this a separate subtask, blocked by the LV half. So this piece copies the final merged bytes and pins `LV_COMMIT` to the squash commit straight away. That removes the re-pin step and the risk of pinning bytes that changed before merge. Bytes and hash are unchanged from the plan.

## What this piece delivers

SD drives the same contract rows as LV, so a reader change on SD's side fails SD's CI. SD has one `DONE:` line rule and one tool-call/result join. SD's notes README stops restating the leftover rule.

## Slice of the approved plan (files and approach)

1. **First, add an explicit known-area switch** in `test/runner-contract.test.js` that throws on any unknown area. Today unknown areas fall through to the generic `drive(row)` (`runOnce`) and fail only by accident. Land the switch before you add rows.
2. **Per-column shape rule** (`test/runner-contract.test.js:160-164`): replace `r.kit !== r.sd ⇒ difference` with the same rule as LV, applied per column present. Otherwise every `report` row, which has no `kit` column, fails.
3. **Re-copy the complete contract** to `test/fixtures/runner-contract.json`. It must be `cmp`-identical to LV's merged `lib/runner-kit/contract.json`. Update `LV_COMMIT` and `FIXTURE_SHA256`. This includes the four LIN-3805 `store` rows that SD never copied. Drive every row, or list it in `UNPINNED` with a reason, as `halt-text` is.
4. **Drive the new areas:** the `report` rows through `sessionPrs` (and `selectCanonical(buildLinkReport(...).tracked, sessionPrs(lines))` for the own-PR row), and the `sentinel` rows through `parseCompletionSentinel`.
5. **Extract into** `transcript.js` (the one module that both `links.js` and `hook.js` import):
   * `doneLineRest(line)` returns the rest of the line after an optional indent and a case-sensitive leading `DONE:`, or null. `parseCompletionSentinel` uses it and keeps "first line wins". `sessionPrs` uses it and keeps "newest wins". It replaces `DONE_LINE_RE` in `links.js`.
   * `toolCallsWithResults(lines)` joins `tool_use` to `tool_result` by id. `walkToolActivity` and `sessionPrs` use it.
   * Leave `heartbeat.js`'s outstanding-wait join alone, because it has a different purpose.
6. `docs/areas/README.md`**:** "One home for each leftover" stops restating the routes. Replace them with a prose pointer: the rule is Harbour's `LEFTOVER_RULE` (`lib/prompts/leftover-words.js` in LinearViewer), which Harbour renders into every SD task's prompts.

## Testing strategy

* **B1 (SD half):** every `sd` cell of the `report` and `sentinel` rows is pinned through SD's real readers.
* **B4:** `cmp` against LV's merged contract shows no difference, and every row has a pin or an `UNPINNED` entry. An unknown area throws.
* **B5:** a new transcript test where results arrive out of order: they still join to their uses, and `created` follows `tool_use` order.
* **B6:** `stop-relay-order-characterization` (the golden), `lin-4375-session-pr`, `links` and `transcript` pass unchanged.
* The full SD suite passes.

## Acceptance

* The witnesses above are green, the full suite passes, and `cmp` is clean.
* Reader selection semantics are kept: the sentinel takes the first matching line, and PR selection takes the newest. The four matchers are not merged, and `links.js` does not skip DECISION blocks.

**Starting point:** the approved plan on the parent, LIN-4377, is where this piece starts. Read it in full in LIN-4377's description, under `## Implementation Plan`. Also read the review notes in its `### Plan Review Verdict` comment (`02638fca-56a0-4f51-bf1d-a15528a50fc5`) and the `## Constraints` and `## Open questions` in the brief (`GET /api/proxy/brief/LIN-4377`). The words the person used are in the parent's `## As asked` block. Follow the plan. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4377.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4377's approving plan-review (comment 02638fca-56a0-4f51-bf1d-a15528a50fc5, rev 1)
Grounding commits: LinearViewer `110e35e0`, simple-dispatcher `cb79e00`. Re-checked at breakdown on 2026-11-08: neither repo has a commit since the ticket was filed.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

**Outcome (close-out, 2026-11-08):** implemented in [simple-dispatcher PR #332](<https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/332>), merged as `59a0dc2` and deployed to the host. The plan slice was implemented as approved. Review accepted the departures (comment "Review — LIN-4385"): the README names the real `LEFTOVER_RULE` rendering sites, and the shared join joins a result written before its use and keeps the last of repeated result ids. Close-out added `9620f44` (`pinReport` asserts both readings on every report row). Blocked by LIN-4384 (Done); the fixture is pinned to LV `936f52b7`. Not run: the live post-deploy `[done]` check on the first post-merge SD run that opens a PR (see the close-out comment). The full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

parent.title: LIN-4347 second tidy-after: the run store knows less about leftovers; the two repos agree by test, not prose

comments.body:
## LIN-4384 merged: the replacement contract hash

LIN-4384's [PR #2365](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2365) is merged into LinearViewer `main` as squash commit **`936f52b7d4c0a8d6d5d0b37b98b6377ab0a62963`**. LIN-4385 is unblocked.

**What to pin in simple-dispatcher:**
- `LV_COMMIT`: `936f52b7d4c0a8d6d5d0b37b98b6377ab0a62963`
- `FIXTURE_SHA256`: `250b6ebf7d0cd38b0cd0524ead48553906062dbabed291ef28f510744ba3be8c`
  - This is the sha256 of `lib/runner-kit/contract.json` at that commit. I re-hashed it from `git show 936f52b7d:lib/runner-kit/contract.json`.

**This supersedes** the `86795d9f7f05…115d` value in LIN-4384's earlier comments. Close-out commit `4ccf8efe7` changed the input of both "an indented DONE: line still counts" rows (review finding 1). The message now mentions #2357 before the indented `DONE:` line, so Harbour's first-PR fallback can no longer satisfy that row. No expected value changed. Re-probed on simple-dispatcher `cb79e00`: report gives `…/pull/101`, sentinel gives `done` (counted as `finished`).

Copy the file byte for byte from `936f52b7d`.

## LIN-4385 built: PR open, CI green

**PR:** https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/332
- Head `86099173bf818732ac667e91f8cccbad5d202762`, branch `feat/lin-4385-contract-recopy-shared-readers`.
- CI: `unit tests` passed on that head (2m44s).
- Local `npm test`: 4,333 tests, 4,327 pass, 0 fail, 6 skipped.

**What landed, by plan step:**
1. **Known-area switch** in `test/runner-contract.test.js`, landed before any new row. An unknown area throws. Before, a temporary `no-such-area` row passed by accident through the generic dispatcher drive.
2. **Per-column shape rule**, the same as LinearViewer's. A `report` row with no `kit` column is now well formed; under the old rule every one failed.
3. **Re-copy** of `test/fixtures/runner-contract.json` from LinearViewer `936f52b7` (#2365's merged squash). `cmp` is clean and the sha256 is `250b6ebf7d0cd38b0cd0524ead48553906062dbabed291ef28f510744ba3be8c`. `LV_COMMIT` and `FIXTURE_SHA256` are re-pinned. The file has 52 rows, including the four LIN-3805 `store` rows.
4. **Every row is driven or listed as not driven with a reason.**
   - `report` (7 rows) go through `sessionPrs`. The LIN-4375 row goes through `selectCanonical(buildLinkReport(...).tracked, sessionPrs(lines))`.
   - `sentinel` (7 rows) go through `parseCompletionSentinel`.
   - Three `store` rows go through SD's real readers.
   - Not driven, with reasons: `store:status` (SD has no reader for that endpoint), plus the existing `halt-text` and `cap:decision`.
5. **`doneLineRest` and `toolCallsWithResults` now live in `transcript.js`.** I pinned the old behaviour with characterization tests first.
   - The sentinel still takes the first line and the PR pick still takes the newest.
   - The four matchers are not merged, and `links.js` still reads DECISION blocks.
   - B5 (results that arrive out of order) failed on the old code and passes now.
   - B6: the existing tests are unchanged (`git diff main` over those four files is 0 lines).
6. **`docs/areas/README.md`** now points to Harbour's `LEFTOVER_RULE` instead of restating it.

**Behaviour changes on a shared path** (also in the PR body):
- `sessionPrs`' list of PRs the session created now follows the order `gh pr create` ran (planned, B5).
- A result written before its use now joins.
- A repeated result id counts once (the last).
- The line-splitting difference between links.js and hook.js (`\r`, U+2028 and U+2029) is kept and pinned.

**Departures from the LIN-4377 plan:** two small ones, written up on LIN-4377. The README names where Harbour actually renders the rule, and the join has two small behaviour shifts beyond the planned one.

Not merged and not set to Done: review and close-out own those steps.

## Review — LIN-4385

Reviewed [simple-dispatcher PR #332](https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/332) at head `86099173bf818732ac667e91f8cccbad5d202762` (base `main` `be6e08b`, MERGEABLE).

CI: green. `unit tests` passed on `8609917` (run 42476649846). I also ran `npm test` myself on that head: 4,333 tests, 4,327 pass, 0 fail, 6 skipped.

### Against what was asked, step by step
1. **Known-area switch.** Done. `sdPin` throws `unknown contract area "<area>"` for an area it doesn't know. Commit `acb61ba` lands it before any row. Mutation: I made the default case fall through to `pinRunOnce`, and the known-area test failed.
2. **Per-column shape rule.** Done. `columnProblems` uses LV's rule: `sd` plus `kit` and/or `harbour`, and any column that differs needs a `difference`. It has tests with bad rows. `report` rows (with no `kit` column) now pass.
3. **Re-copy.** Done. I fetched `lib/runner-kit/contract.json` from LV `936f52b7d4c0a8d6d5d0b37b98b6377ab0a62963` myself, and **`cmp` is clean** against `test/fixtures/runner-contract.json`. Both sha256 values are `250b6ebf…ba3be8c`. `LV_COMMIT` and `FIXTURE_SHA256` match the constraint. The file has 52 rows, including the 4 `store` rows. LV `main`'s history for that file still ends at `936f52b7`, so the copy is current. Every row is either pinned or listed in `UNPINNED` with a reason (`halt-text`, `cap:decision`, `store:status`). A permanent test enforces this both ways.
4. **Drive the new areas.** Done. `report` rows go through `sessionPrs`, and the LIN-4375 row goes through `selectCanonical(buildLinkReport(...).tracked, sessionPrs(lines))`. `sentinel` rows go through `parseCompletionSentinel(latestAssistantText(...))`.
5. **Extract into `transcript.js`.** Done. `doneLineRest` replaces `DONE_LINE_RE` and hook.js's inline `DONE:` regex. `toolCallsWithResults` serves both `walkToolActivity` and `sessionPrs`. `heartbeat.js` is untouched.
   - I checked the equivalence by reading the code. `/^\s*DONE:(.*)\s*$/` on the untrimmed line gives the same result as the old `trim()` followed by `/^DONE:\s*(.*)$/`, for both detection and detail. `.` does not cross `\r`, U+2028 or U+2029, and `trim`/`\s` remove the same characters. On `sessionPrs`' side, splitting on `[\n\r  ]` matches what the old `m`-flag regex treated as line ends.
   - `walkToolActivity`'s output is byte-for-byte the same as before: the loop moved, it did not change.
6. **README.** Done. The README now points to `LEFTOVER_RULE`. I checked the departure against LV `main`: `LEFTOVER_RULE` is defined in `lib/prompts/leftover-words.js` and rendered only by `lib/dispatch-leftover.js` and `lib/prompt-template-defs.js` (review and close-out). The README's narrower wording is accurate, and the plan's "every SD task's prompts" was not. I accept the departure.

**Acceptance.** The selection rules are kept: the sentinel takes the first matching line, and the PR pick takes the newest. The four matchers are not merged. `links.js` does not skip DECISION blocks. B6 is unchanged: `git diff main` over the four golden files is empty, and all four pass.

### Open question: the two extra join behaviour changes
I assessed both and accept them. The plan named only one change, so this needed a ruling, and there is none (`rulings?issueIdentifier=LIN-4385` is empty).
- **A result written before its use now joins.** `walkToolActivity` already read it this way. For `sessionPrs`, it can only add a PR printed by a `gh pr create` the session really ran, so it cannot pick a PR from elsewhere.
- **A repeated result id counts once (last wins).** This matches `walkToolActivity`. Before, a duplicated result line added its PRs twice to `created`. `created` is only consulted for membership and order, so no realistic transcript loses a PR this way.

Both changes come from using one shared join, which is what the parent asked for. Neither needs a person's decision.

### Mutation checks (each reverted; the tree was clean afterwards)
| mutation | went red |
|---|---|
| `doneLineRest` with no indent | 4 tests, including `report:` and `sentinel: an indented DONE: line still counts` |
| `DONE_LINE` made case-insensitive | the case-sensitivity characterization test |
| join keeps the first result instead of the last | `a repeated result id keeps the last result` |
| `created` oldest first | B5 `two gh pr create runs whose results arrive in reverse` |
| `reported` oldest first | 6 tests, including `report: two DONE: lines` and the DECISION-then-real row |
| sentinel uses an anchored regex on the raw line | 4 tests (indent, CRLF) |
| `sessionPrs` splits only on `\n` | 2 tests for `\r` / U+2028 |
| `sdPin` default falls through | the unknown-area test |

### Regression check
The recent commits on `hook.js`, `links.js`, `transcript.js` and the contract test are `cb79e00` (LIN-4375: newest `DONE:` line, own PR) and `bf499a4` / `796bc9d` (relay order). The LIN-4375 order fix still holds: `newestGroupsFirst` is unchanged, `lin-4375-session-pr` passes unchanged, and the "reported oldest first" mutation turns it red. Nothing that was reverted comes back. There are no commits on `main` touching these paths since the ticket was filed, apart from the unrelated LIN-4378 broker work.

### One of a class?
The class is "two copies of one transcript rule". This PR closes the two siblings the ticket bounded: the `DONE:` matcher and the tool join. The other `DONE:` readers (Harbour's `REPORT_LINE_RE` and `OUTCOME_LINE`) are deliberately not merged, as the ticket requires, and the contract rows hold them in line. `heartbeat.js`'s walk has a different purpose, as the plan says. I found no other siblings.

### Leftovers (one home each)
- **Fix-sized, inside the area, to fix on the PR branch.** `test/runner-contract.test.js` `pinReport` picks its reader with `/LIN-4375/.test(row.case)`, which keys on prose. If LV renames that case, the row silently drops back to `own.reported[0]` and stops exercising `selectCanonical`, and stays green.
  - Fix: drop the regex and assert **both** readings on every `report` row: `own.reported[0] ?? null` and `selectCanonical(buildLinkReport(lines).tracked, own)?.canon ?? null` each `=== row.sd`.
  - I checked that this passes on the current table: every report row comes out the same both ways. It keeps all the mutations above sensitive.
- The builder posted no other `### Leftovers` comment. The `stop-hook-and-relay` Waiting entry about the second `DONE:` matcher was rightly removed in this change, because the change settles it.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (a claim this change depends on: the shared readers on real transcripts). CI drives `sessionPrs` and `parseCompletionSentinel` only with synthetic one-line transcripts (`assistantLine`) and the existing fixtures. **After the deploy:** the first SD-dispatched run that opens a PR after the merge should post `[done]` with its own PR's url, and Harbour should count it as finished. A wrong result looks like `[done]` carrying a different PR, or no `[done]` while the transcript ends with a `DONE:` line. **Rollback:** revert PR #332's squash commit. It changes no data and no persisted shape.

The one-way drift the PR describes (LV re-pins an `sd` change without SD re-copying) is a known, accepted limit, not a claim this deliverable depends on. It is not a ledger item.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

Close-out should apply the `pinReport` fix described under Leftovers on the PR branch, re-check CI on the new head, merge, then run the post-deploy check above.

## Close-out — LIN-4385

**Merged:** [simple-dispatcher PR #332](https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/332) as merge commit **`59a0dc2d67d3f41d529750a1050d3b39f0cc1819`** (2026-11-08 11:53:15 UTC). The merge was pinned with `--match-head-commit` to head `9620f44afc6bb4b982be60d04edcd7095cb0098e`.

**How it meets the ask:** review's step-by-step account stands (comment "Review — LIN-4385", verdict Approve conditional on the ledger).
- The 52-row contract is a `cmp`-identical copy of LV `936f52b7`.
- An unknown area throws.
- The per-column shape rule is in place.
- `report` and `sentinel` rows go through SD's real readers.
- `doneLineRest` and `toolCallsWithResults` live in `transcript.js`.
- The README points to `LEFTOVER_RULE`.

### What close-out changed (after the approval)
| commit | change | review line it answers |
|---|---|---|
| `9620f44` | `pinReport` no longer picks its reader by `/LIN-4375/.test(row.case)`. Every `report` row now asserts both `own.reported[0] ?? null` and `selectCanonical(buildLinkReport(lines).tracked, own)?.canon ?? null` against `row.sd`. The comment above it was made stale by this change and is updated in the same commit. | Leftovers: "Fix-sized, inside the area, to fix on the PR branch … assert **both** readings on every `report` row" |

- **Mutation:** I replaced the canonical reading with `tracked[0]` (no own-PR preference). 5 `report` rows went red. The old code would have caught this on the LIN-4375 row only. Reverted afterwards.
- **Note entries:** review named none, so none were written.

### Ledger
- **Leftover: `pinReport` keys on prose (inside).** Settled by `9620f44`, with the mutation above as evidence.
- **Shared readers on real transcripts (inside, post-deploy).**
  - **Deploy landed:** the host checkout `~/development/simple-dispatcher` is at `59a0dc2`, and `watch-restart.sh` restarted the dispatcher at 11:53:55 GMT.
  - **Live check: not run.** No SD-dispatched run had opened a PR since the restart when close-out ran, and the check needs a future run.
    - **Who can run it:** the operator, on the first such run. Its `[done]` must carry its own PR url, and Harbour must count it as finished.
    - **Failure looks like:** `[done]` with another PR, or no `[done]` while the transcript ends with a `DONE:` line.
    - **Rollback** (review's): revert PR #332's merge commit, `git revert -m 1 59a0dc2`. No data or persisted shape changes.
    - **Recorded on the PR:** https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/332#issuecomment-6721165866
  - **Offline check on the deployed code:** I replayed 527 real SD transcripts from the last 3 days through the deployed readers (`59a0dc2`) and the pre-merge ones (`be6e08b`).
    - Calls compared: `sessionPrs`, `selectCanonical(buildLinkReport().tracked, …)`, and `parseCompletionSentinel(latestAssistantText(…))`.
    - Result: 0 differences in the `[done]` url, `reported`, the `created` set or the sentinel kind.
    - All 82 transcripts that opened a PR resolve `[done]` to the session's own PR.
    - This exercises the real readers on real transcripts, but not the live posting path.
- **Outside items:** none. Nothing was filed.

### CI
`unit tests` passed on `9620f44` (run 42477456354, 2m58s). Local `npm test` on that head: 4,333 tests, 4,327 pass, 0 fail, 6 skipped.

### Related tickets
- **LIN-4384:** already Done.
- **LIN-4377 (parent):** stays open, because LIN-4383 (Part A) is still In Progress. A note is posted there that Part B is now complete on both repos.

## Autopilot (stepper) run summary — LIN-4385

**Outcome:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/332 merged as `59a0dc2d67d3f41d529750a1050d3b39f0cc1819`; LIN-4385 Done. CI `unit tests` green on PR head `9620f44` and on the merge commit (checked by me via the check-runs API). Model `opus` on every stage.

**Beats run (one warm session, implementation kind), each judged before advancing:**
1. Orient, known-area switch, per-column shape rule, re-copy contract. Judged: I re-hashed LV `936f52b7:lib/runner-kit/contract.json` = `250b6ebf…8c`; unknown-area witness showed old code passing by accident and new code throwing; only the 18 undriven rows red.
2. Drive `report`/`sentinel`/`store` rows. Judged: nine mutation witnesses with failing output; `store:status` listed UNPINNED with a reason (no SD reader). Challenged the gap that no sentinel row separates first-wins from newest-wins, pushed to beat 3.
3. Extract `doneLineRest` / `toolCallsWithResults`. Judged: characterization pinned first (old matchers' differences enumerated), four golden test files diff = 0 lines, B5 failed-then-passed output. Behaviour changes on the shared join were surfaced for the PR.
4. README pointer, push, PR, CI, Linear. Judged: PR #332 open, head matched, `unit tests` success; diff of removed test lines showed re-indentation into the area switch, not dropped assertions.

Then engine-chosen `review` (conditional Approve, comment ea6b7fb8, own `cmp` + test run + 8 mutations) and `close-out` (pinReport fix, merge pinned to the CI-green head, deploy checked, description snapshot and prune).

**What holds:** contract copy cmp-identical; every row driven or UNPINNED with reason (`halt-text`, `cap:decision`, `store:status`); unknown area throws; sentinel first-line and PR newest-line semantics kept; four matchers not merged; `links.js` does not skip DECISION blocks.

**What's left (not mine):** the live post-deploy `[done]` check was not run (no SD run has opened a PR since the deploy); recorded by close-out for the operator, with an offline replay of 527 real transcripts as a substitute that cannot prove the live posting step. LIN-4377 stays open pending LIN-4383 (Part A).

**Noted:** workers' commit trailers say Claude Opus 5.5 rather than the Sonnet 5.5 line in my beat prompts; the workers' own attribution rule applied.

issue.title: LIN-4377 Part B1: runner contract pins report and sentinel cases, with shape check and hash tripwire (LinearViewer)
